verdict.rationale: Codex docs say you can choose the model and reasoning effort for a task, and hands-on community reports mention picking between OpenAI models such as gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.3-codex-spark in the CLI. All evidenced models come from OpenAI, and nothing shows the session being powered by other providers' models, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-provider model selection (e.g. Anthropic/Google or custom provider configuration), and documentation of how model switching works per session.
